fixture_setup: supabase/schema.sql (all releases; run the 'Final release' section once) and supabase/seed.sql (Release 1 data). legacy_export.json and scale_fixture.json were imported through the staff page /staff/migrate (the product's own import path, no SQL); reports are downloadable from that page and summarised in docs/MIGRATION.md and docs/SCALE-TEST.md. Release 3 demo fixtures: /demos/working-demo.html, /demos/fallback.svg, plus /demos/webgl-demo.html. Release 4 company pages: /fixtures/r4/*.html.
test_access: Public/employer: no account. Student/contributor: reviewers sign in with their own GitHub account and verify their own @algomau.ca email at /student (no shared passwords). Staff: the same kind of account, then /staff and the staff access code given only in the Moodle Online text under 'Reviewer test access' (copied to the reviewers' QA target page). 'Turn off staff tools' on /staff returns the account to an ordinary student. The code is not in the repository.
